description.value: A McDonald's franchise on King George Boulevard, a major arterial road through Surrey, with a drive-through in addition to standard counter service. The location offers the full McDonald's Canada menu including McCafé beverages, McValue meals, and seasonal limited-time items. Touring cyclists riding through Surrey along King George Boulevard will find this a reliable and familiar stop for food and drinks.
